record.content: The current backpack-camping FAQ lists, in Del Valle-to-Mission Peak order, Boyd Camp sites 1-2, Stewart's Camp, Maggie's Half Acre sites 1-3, Doe Camp sites 1-2, the seven named Sunol Backpack Camp sites, and Eagle Springs sites 1-4. It states that these sites require advance reservations made at least two business days ahead and prohibit dogs, alcohol, campfires or barbecues, and bicycles.
